intro.label: Introduction
intro.title: Staying Connected to Faith, Wherever You Are
intro.text:
Faith is more than a tradition. It is a connection to our roots, our families and the values passed down through generations. Hindu.international focuses on making that connection easier to maintain by helping people access spiritual services and religious practices according to their situation.

Some people want to follow their religious traditions whether they live near a sacred place or thousands of miles away. Hindu.international provides different puja, ritual and spiritual services so people can choose the services that suit their needs and stay connected to their traditions.

process.label: Our Work Process
process.title: A Simple Process to Stay Connected with Your Faith

steps.title: Choose Your Service
steps.text: Explore our available spiritual services and select the one that suits your needs or your family's religious traditions.

steps.title: Share Your Details
steps.text: Once you select a service, share the necessary details with us. You can tell us about your requirements and preferences so our team can understand your needs and guide you.

steps.title: We Make the Arrangements
steps.text: After receiving your details, our team coordinates the arrangements according to your selected service and the rituals.

steps.title: Stay Connected During the Process
steps.text: We keep you updated about your booking so you can stay connected to your religious traditions, even when you cannot visit a sacred place in person.

leftItems.title: Different Services in One Place
leftItems.text: People want to follow different religious traditions at different times. Hindu.international brings a range of spiritual services together on one platform, making it easier to find spiritual services.

leftItems.title: Respect for Religious Traditions
leftItems.text: Every puja and ritual has its own customs and importance. We understand this and focus on making arrangements with care and devotion.

leftItems.title: Beyond Puja and Festivals
leftItems.text: Religious traditions are also part of family life, remembering ancestors, helping others and serving the community. We bring these aspects of spiritual life together so people can explore services that matter to them.

rightItems.title: For Those Who Cannot Travel
rightItems.text: Visiting a temple or attending a religious event is not always possible. Our virtual services give people another way to take part in certain religious practices when they cannot be there in person.

rightItems.title: Clear Service Details
rightItems.text: We explain each service in simple words so people can understand the details before booking and feel comfortable with their decision.

purpose.label: Our Purpose
purpose.title: Building a Platform for Hindu Traditions

items.title: Keeping Traditions Alive
items.text: Our family traditions have been followed for generations. We want to keep them alive for future generations.

items.title: Bringing People Together
items.text: Faith connects people through shared customs, festivals and religious practices. We want Hindu.international to be a place where people can explore and learn more about these traditions.

items.title: Supporting Community Welfare
items.text: We support our community and spread awareness so people don't have to leave their religious traditions because of difficult situations. We want everyone to feel free to follow their beliefs and make their own choices without pressure.

items.title: Growing for the Future
items.text: We focus on building Hindu.international into a platform that continues to grow with new ideas, useful resources and services related to Hindu traditions and spiritual life.

bottomCta.title: Let Your Spiritual Journey Continue, Wherever You Are
bottomCta.text: Your connection with faith does not have to depend on where you live or how far you are from a sacred place. Explore the possibilities, discover services that suit your needs and stay connected with the traditions that matter to you.
